title: Code Triage — Mass Casualty Incident

fields.text: Code Triage, Code Triage. Mass casualty incident. All department managers report to the Hospital Command Center. Surgical Pavilion, Imaging and Laboratory: report your capacity to the HCC. All staff: downtime procedures are in effect. Code Triage, Code Triage.
fields.voiceDirection: Calm, authoritative male voice, steady pace, slight echo
fields.terminalAmbience: Hospital corridor, distant intercom chatter, muffled footsteps
fields.deliveryNote: Play the audio on all hospital PA zones. Do not explain it.
fields.scenarioTitle: Core Collapse — Mass Casualty Surge During a Network Outage

instructorNote: This inject triggers full HICS activation. Watch for the AOC to call for the first HCC meeting and for the CNO to initiate the call-in tree.
